fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of a master's in computer science at Sheffield? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadlines.

The Computer Science MSc is a **1-year**, full-time conversion course. A conversion course teaches computing to graduates from other subjects. Sheffield describes it as an intensive, one-year conversion master's degree for graduates from any non-computing discipline. It starts in late September 2027 and lasts 12 months.

**The most important fact for you:** your degree must be in a non-computing subject. If you hold a BTech, BE or BCA in computer science, this course is not for you.

You study Programming, Algorithms and Data Structures (**30 credits**), then 15-credit modules in Introduction to Software Engineering, Professional Issues, Team Development Project, Cybersecurity Principles and Practices, Principles of Artificial Intelligence and Research Methods. Over the summer you write a **60-credit** Dissertation Project.

For the wider university, see our [University of Sheffield page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-sheffield).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need at least a 2:1 honours degree in a non-computing subject. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade. You must also show an understanding of mathematical principles, from modules in your degree or from A Level Mathematics or equivalent.

**Indian marks.** Sheffield's India page lists **60%** for a 2:1, **55%** for a 2:2 and **65%** for a First. The score you need depends on the university you attended and the course. Sheffield asks you to upload a grading key that converts your GPA to a percentage, if you can.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. This course asks for **IELTS 6.5**, with **6** in each component.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Sheffield's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**. Sheffield's deadlines page advises applying for ATAS by **16 August 2027** if your course needs it.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£34,550** a year for September 2027 (the 2027-28 overseas fee).

Sheffield is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | £34,550 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£47,099** |

The sum is £34,550 + £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £47,099. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Application fee and deposit.** No application fee or deposit is listed on the course or deadlines pages.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**International Postgraduate Scholarship 2027.** Sheffield gives a **£7,000** tuition fee reduction to eligible offer holders from listed countries, and India is on the list. It is automatic, with no separate form. With it, your first-year total falls to **£40,099**.

To get it you must:

- be a permanent resident of India, or have lived there for the last three years
- be self-funded and classed as overseas for fees
- study full-time, starting September 2027
- accept your offer before **4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027**

**Stacking.** The scholarship cannot be combined with any other Sheffield scholarship or discount unless Sheffield says so. It also cannot be combined with funding from an external sponsor (a loan you repay is fine). Read the [scholarship terms](https://sheffield.ac.uk/international/fees-and-funding/scholarships/postgraduate/2027).

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Date | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | Everyone | 15 September 2026 | Applications open |
| September 2027 | Applicants who need a visa | 26 August 2027 | Last date to apply |
| September 2027 | Everyone | 3 September 2027, 17:00 BST | Applications close |
| September 2027 | Applicants who need a visa | 6 September 2027 | Apply for your CAS by this date |

Teaching begins on **27 September 2027**. To keep the scholarship, accept your offer before **6 July 2027**, so in practice apply well before then.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** Make sure you meet the degree rule and have about 60% or the equivalent for your university.
2. **Prepare your documents.** Sheffield does not ask for references or a supporting statement for this course. Have your transcripts, degree certificate, grading key and English test result ready.
3. **Apply online.** Use the Apply link on the [course page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/computer-science-msc).
4. **Accept your offer before 6 July 2027.** This keeps the automatic £7,000 scholarship.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate. If so, apply by 16 August 2027.
6. **Apply for your CAS.** CAS applications begin in June 2027. Apply by 6 September 2027. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs.
7. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Careers.** The course aims to prepare you for roles in software and the technology sector.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- your degree is in engineering (other than computing), science, commerce or arts, and you want a tech career
- you have about 60% from your Indian university
- you want the automatic **£7,000** scholarship

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in computer science or IT, because the course is for non-computing graduates
- you want to stack the scholarship with another Sheffield discount, because the terms do not allow it

faq_json.q: Can I do the Sheffield MSc Computer Science with a BTech in computer science?
faq_json.a: No. It is a conversion course that needs a 2:1 honours degree in a non-computing subject.

faq_json.q: How much does the Sheffield MSc Computer Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £34,550 for 2027-28. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the year comes to £47,099, or £40,099 after the £7,000 scholarship.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: Sheffield's India page lists 60% for a 2:1. The score can depend on your university.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Yes. The International Postgraduate Scholarship gives £7,000 off tuition automatically if you accept your offer before 6 July 2027. It cannot be combined with other Sheffield awards or discounts.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for September 2027?
faq_json.a: If you need a visa, the last date to apply is 26 August 2027. Applications close on 3 September 2027.
